content.text:
I've changed `totalPaidCents` in `src/services/order-service.js:8`, but I haven't run the tests, as you asked. The existing test will fail now: by reading, it expects the old total.

**What changed:** the function first looks up soft-deleted users (`deleted_at !== null`). It then sums paid, non-deleted orders whose `user_id` isn't one of those users. It still uses callbacks throughout, and an error from either lookup goes to the callback the same way as before.

With the seed data, Alan (user 3) is soft-deleted, so his $5.00 paid order (#13) drops out. The report total goes from 14600 to 14100 cents.

**Test to update:** `tests/order-service.test.js:17` still expects `4200 + 9900 + 500`. It should become `4200 + 9900`. I didn't edit the test because you only asked for the service change.

**Decision for you:** I excluded orders from deleted users rather than keeping only orders from active users. The difference is an order whose `user_id` has no matching user record: it is still counted.

`OrderRepository.findPaid()` in `src/repositories/order-repository.js` (the Chapter 5 migration target) still includes deleted users' orders. If the report moves onto the repository later, it will need the same filter.
